topic: What the witness observed in the coffee shop

statements.text: I was just there getting my morning coffee, bro. Totally random, just in the wrong place at the wrong time, you know?
statements.press_response: I mean, I go there like, sometimes. It's a solid spot.

statements.text: I saw the dude pull out the bill himself from his own jacket pocket. Nobody was near him, it was just him fumbling around.
statements.press_response: Yeah, a hundred percent. He reached into his left pocket and pulled it out. Nobody else touched anything.

statements.text: I've never even seen that guy before in my life. Total stranger to me.
statements.press_response: Look, I meet a lot of people for my podcast. I can't remember everyone.
